title: Finitistic dimensions of formal power series rings
summary: We consider the big finitistic projective and flat dimensions of a commutative ring and of its formal power series ring. When the ring is Noetherian, both invariants increase by one. Coherence of the power series ring does not force either equality to hold. For every \(n\ge0\) and every \(d\) with \(n+1\le d\le\infty\), the flat pair \((n,d)\) can be realized. The finite projective pairs are realized when \(n\ge1\), and also for \((0,1)\). For every \(n\ge0\), one family realizes \((n,\infty)\) for both invariants at the same time.
